q: How are the emissions from dredging a port channel counted?
title: Port channel dredging: emissions
short: Dredgers burn large amounts of marine diesel to cut, pump and dump sediment. The dredging contractor reports that fuel as Scope 1. A port authority that hires the contractor reports it as Scope 3, or as Scope 1 if it runs its own dredgers. Record fuel per cubic metre moved.

ul: Fuel bought for each dredger, from bunker delivery notes.

p: Capital dredging for a new berth is a one-off project. Maintenance dredging repeats every year and belongs in your annual inventory.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
